# Question: generator-shortcuts

## Strongest plausible shortcut

The strongest rule that fits every labeled canonical pair is:

> Treat color 2 as the horizontal arm and color 3 as the vertical arm; ignore
> every other color or unexpected orientation, and paint only those two spans in 8.

All three canonical inputs use exactly that color/orientation assignment, so
`fixed_color_roles` reproduces all three canonical outputs. It is declared in
`CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS` and independently checked by the semantic gate.

## How it was checked

The input passes the final generator's `self_check`. I ran the selected authority
through `arcpuzzles apply`; the receipt records rule hash `4a7acff260a8`, final
generator SHA-256 `c20bbec95c273fc794b565af52a12702ae1a9ebdc5c11475c0245f3662d6e014`, and `valid_output: true` at
`checks/counterexamples/0eabac67e70a/fixed_color_roles_swapped.racket.json`.
The complete input, rival output, authority output, differing cells, seed, and
overrides are retained in
`repo/generators/0eabac67e70a/counterexamples/fixed_color_roles_swapped.json`.

Yes—the proposed generator emits the exact case above, and its ordinary lesson
sampler emits many equivalent role-breaking cases. The final 300-lesson census
found zero production or rotated-query ambiguities against this declared rival.
